errors.reason: Misleading decade: Michael Irvin entered the NFL in 1988 and his stardom (Pro Bowls, Cowboys Super Bowls) came in the 1990s. He was a college star at Miami in the mid-1980s, but 'a 1980s star' does not accurately describe him and invites other 5-letter Michaels (see ambiguous).
Minor terminology error: Joe Torre was an MLB manager, not a coach. In baseball, 'manager' and 'coach' are distinct roles; the clue should read 'MLB manager Joe ___'.
Minor terminology error: Tony La Russa was an MLB manager, not a coach. Should be 'MLB manager Tony La ___'.

ambiguous.alt: ALLEN — Ray Allen (Basketball Hall of Fame, 2018) is also a 5-letter Hall of Famer named Ray; with no sport specified, LEWIS and ALLEN fit equally well.
NASH — Steve Nash was also an NBA head coach (Nets, 2020-22) and fits the same 4 letters; Kerr is the more canonical answer but the clue does not disambiguate.
CHANG — Michael Chang (1989 French Open champion) is a genuine 1980s star with a 5-letter surname; given Irvin's stardom was actually the 1990s, CHANG arguably fits the clue better.
